A direct local-resolver DS query returned original key tag 23596 with remaining TTL 55686 seconds, while parent authorities publish recovery key 38997. This confirms stale old-DS cache divergence, with roughly 15.5 hours left in this particular sampled cache. Ordinary local fetch and built-in browser recovery remain unconfirmed. No resolver configuration, certificate validation or OS security setting changed.
